# Bundled ALAC decoder

`alac-decoder.mjs` is the browser ESM build of `@mgz-dev/alac` 0.1.1, pinned to upstream commit `7ad4e9b107a2175ffaaef1a4827988c1a9da906a`:

<https://github.com/marcogomez/alac/tree/7ad4e9b107a2175ffaaef1a4827988c1a9da906a>

It is MIT-licensed and includes derived ALAC decoder work; retain both [`alac-LICENSE.txt`](./alac-LICENSE.txt) and [`alac-NOTICE.txt`](./alac-NOTICE.txt).
